scope: Read-only local dataset and project asset audit

repository_image_scan.scope: All readable image-like files outside frontend dependencies, build output, and virtual environments
non_dataset_metadata: Some generated plots contain ordinary PNG Software and dpi metadata.
No wavelength, band, sensor, reflectance, CRS, or geotransform metadata was found.

ndvi.reason: Requires NIR and red reflectance; local files have RGB only and no calibration metadata.

ndwi.reason: Established McFeeters and Gao variants require NIR, and the Gao variant also requires SWIR; local files have neither.

model_compatibility.reason: The model and checkpoint are fixed to three input and three output channels.

recommended_next_steps: Select an official multispectral source and preserve band metadata.
Validate scale factors, QA masks, alignment, nodata, CRS, and geotransforms.
Create a separate multispectral split and do not mix it with the RGB split.
Design and train a new multispectral-compatible model/checkpoint.
Validate NDVI and NDWI against their intended band formulas before application integration.
